# Cited Research

A monorepo of citation-backed research documents. Every factual claim traces to
a web source visited during the research session, and independent sub-agents
audit the output for citation accuracy and cross-file consistency.

## Organization

Each research topic lives in its own directory under `research/`:

```
research/<topic-slug>/
├── README.md              # Standalone summary and decision framework
├── <deliverable>.md       # Full analysis with methodology
├── citations.md           # All sources, numbered
├── references/            # One file per research dimension
│   └── <dimension>.md
└── audit/                 # Independent verification reports
    ├── citation-audit.md
    └── consistency-review.md
```

## Methodology

Research follows the [cited-research](https://github.com/jewzaam/cited-research)
skill methodology:

1. **Plan** — decompose into dimensions, get approval
2. **Research** — parallel sub-agents with web sources only
3. **Organize** — citations and reference files before writing
4. **Write** — every claim cited, writer knows audit follows
5. **Verify** — independent citation audit and consistency review

## Index

See [index.md](index.md) for a searchable index of all research topics.
